_doc: Calibration targets and assumptions for the C14 simulator. status: VERIFIED = value taken from a cited public source (see research/evidence-numbers.md); PENDING = expected from a public source, not yet verified in this repo; ASSUMPTION = modelling choice. All simulator output is SYNTHETIC.

women_share.source: PMJDY share of accounts held by women (pmjdy.gov.in / PIB)

rural_share.source: PMJDY rural + semi-urban share of accounts

inoperative_target.source: official statement: 'roughly a quarter' of PMJDY accounts inactive; exact share from Parliament answers

district_use_mean.source: NFHS-5 India: women having a bank or savings account they themselves use

district_use_sd.source: spread of district values; replace with real NFHS-5 district distribution

women_phone_own.source: NFHS-5: women having a mobile phone they themselves use

migrated_share.source: persons away from home district (x2 for rural men 18-40)

deceased_share_60p.source: holders aged 60+ who died while the account stays open

women_ct_district_share.source: share of districts with a monthly cash transfer to women

bc_sakhi_district_share.source: share of districts with active BC Sakhis

kyc_due_share_old.source: accounts opened 2014-2016 still pending periodic KYC update

opened_for_dbt_share.source: share of DBT-receiving accounts opened for the purpose of DBT (exempt from the RBI inoperative stipulation)

data_quality_flip.source: accounts whose official inoperative flag disagrees with the ledger
